hosted_trial_findings: 3-week hosted trial metrics: peak QPS observed 14 (burst), sustained QPS ~6; avg tokens per chat response 420 (median 380, tail to 2.4k for long contexts); embeddings calls ~0.8 QPS with avg 768-d vectors; reranking requests small token footprint (~60 tokens) but high QPS spikes at release times. p95 latency on hosted endpoints ~240ms for small models, ~720ms for larger generation flows. Errors: transient timeouts during peak bursts (no data loss).
traffic_forecast_summary: Q1 post-launch forecast (12 months planning window): month1 tokens 10M -> month12 tokens 120M (fast adoption, 3x MAU). Expected workload mix: 60% chat (interactive, latency-sensitive), 30% embeddings (search indexing + similarity), 10% reranking/batch. Target SLOs: p95 < 300ms for critical chat flows. Forecasted peak concurrency: 85 concurrent generation streams during feature toggle windows; steady concurrency average 18. Estimated monthly token mix: 72M chat tokens, 36M embedding tokens (in token-equivalent), 12M rerank tokens by month12.
dedicated_capacity_needs: Recommendation from PoC sizing workshop: start Dedicated with 2 reserved high-memory GPUs (A100-class equivalence) with autoscale headroom to add 1 additional GPU for predictable burst windows. Config: 2 GPUs reserved -> supports ~60 concurrent generation contexts at target batching (with batching latency budget 50-80ms). For cost control, route non-latency-critical reranking and bulk embeddings to quantized model variants on the same pool. Estimated reserved capacity cost maps to ARR band in discussion; will iterate after final token baseline from hosted month-end. Monthly token estimate for Dedicated: 60-120M tokens depending on adoption scenario.
